topic: ZCode, the GLM coding agent, silently uploads your Git history
headline: ZCode and Your Git Privacy
caption:
Just read about ZCode, the GLM coding agent, quietly uploading your Git history without explicit consent. As developers, we rely on tools to enhance productivity but also need transparency. It's crucial to understand what data these models access and how it's used. Always review permissions and stay aware of potential privacy implications. Have you used similar AI tools and checked their data practices? Let’s stay vigilant and ensure our code stays secure and private! 🚀 

#DataPrivacy #AIcoding #DevSecurity
